title: rastinaghighi.dev chat API v1: request body (PROPOSED)
description: Body of POST /api/chat/v1. PROPOSED and not owner-approved: see docs/api/chat-v1.md. The browser sends this body to the gateway, and the gateway sends a freshly serialized copy of the validated value to the inference origin. This schema defines structure only; the ordered validation steps, the Unicode rules and the error code for each failure are in chat-v1.md, section 6.
$comment: Exactly one member is allowed. Every other member (for example history, messages, session_id, model, options, stream, request_id or client_request_id) is rejected with HTTP 400 and error code invalid_request.

message.description: The visitor's question or navigation command, as plain text. Line feeds and tabs are allowed. Length is counted in Unicode code points as sent, not in UTF-16 code units. Unpaired surrogates are rejected (chat-v1.md, section 6). The origin also normalizes the message and applies the same limits again after normalization.
message.$comment: minLength or pattern failure: error code empty_input. maxLength failure: input_too_long. Wrong type: invalid_request. 1000 is the inference application's PROVISIONAL input limit.
